RESOLVED: Dear Ms. Whitfield,

Re: Claim CLM-550193 for brain MRI on August 27, 2026

Thank you for reaching out to us about the denial of your claim. We understand that you have questions about the denial reason "prior authorization not on file" and the appeal process.

As discussed in our previous conversation on September 2, 2026, you have the right to appeal this decision. You may file a first-level appeal within 180 days of the denial notice date. The deadline for your appeal is February 23, 2027.

To initiate the appeal process, please complete the attached appeal form (FORM-APP-1) and submit it to us with any supporting documentation from your provider, including a retrospective authorization request and clinical documentation supporting medical necessity.

We will review your appeal and make a decision within 30 calendar days of receiving your request. If you have any questions or need assistance with the appeal process, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Please find the appeal form attached to this message. If you have any further questions or concerns, you can reach us at +1-800-MERIDIAN (1-800-637-4346) or via our website.

Sincerely,
ARIA
Meridian Health Plan Member Services
